purpose: Define the causal experimental atom surrounding the frozen Layer-0 phenomenon probe, including the model-visible environment stimulus.
trial_atom: tau = (X0, C, E_tilde, e, B, Theta, E_eval_spec) -> I -> A(I,E_eval)

environment_boundary.e1: E_tilde=E1 and E_eval=E1; A->B is absent from the current graph
environment_boundary.required_invariant: e0 and e1 must produce different rendered inputs when the intervention is intended to be observable
environment_boundary.leakage_constraint: the rendered input may expose the changed graph/state but must not name the changed edge as a textual instruction or suggest an alternative solution

identity.observation_hash: SHA-256(canonical TrialSpec + raw_model_output + derived evaluation record)
identity.execution_timestamp: non-custodial observational metadata; excluded from observation_hash by definition

custody.raw_model_output: primary outcome custody object; never human-rewritten

context_control.C1: matched non-frame semantic placebo; adds neutral graph-label context without procedural checking instructions, mechanism hypotheses, exemplars, or alternative paths
context_control.character_count: recorded in ContextSpec; exact token equality is measured at execution

controls.assignment: deterministic domain-separated SHA-256 seed per cell and replicate
controls.ordering: deterministic schedule derived before model execution; order is not an analytical factor
controls.replication: replicates_per_cell fixed prospectively by execution manifest
controls.session: fresh_independent_trial for every trial; no conversation history is carried between trials
controls.budget: ResourceBudget is a hard predeclared limit; concrete runner must reject or flag any execution whose measured usage exceeds it
controls.evaluator: fixed exogenous evaluator specification bound into TrialSpec

analysis_boundary.raw: immutable observation records including exact rendered input and raw output
analysis_boundary.derived: parser/evaluator results and distribution estimates are derived after raw capture
analysis_boundary.secondary: distribution-valued context-by-intervention interaction and descriptive validity/implementation frequencies
forbidden: feeding Layer-0 results into downstream CRANK components before Layer-0 analysis is frozen

claim_ceiling: This artifact establishes an auditable experimental unit with an observable intervention channel, explicit session/budget controls, and assignment/custody semantics; it makes no claim that the Layer-0 phenomenon exists.
